name: Moekasu
source:
Among other goodies there are two stories based on the extended world of Moekan's Kirishima route and Tsui no Sora.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/08/vn-of-month-june-2004-3days-michiteyuku.html]vndbreview[/url]]
